root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic branches: exchange of speech between people, and the contrast or mixture of colors. From speech arise address, discourse, sermon, marriage proposal, and the affair that is a subject of discussion.
root_idea.development: The speech branch extends from mutual verbal exchange to addressing someone, formal discourse, and seeking marriage through a proposal. The sense of an affair is connected with matters that prompt discussion or response. A separate branch denotes variegated or dusky coloration.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form III verb meaning to address or speak to someone.
Distinct Quran-attested noun for a matter or affair at issue.
Distinct Quran-attested noun for speech, address, and the construction فصل الخطاب.
Distinct Quran-attested noun for seeking a woman in marriage or a marriage proposal.

senses.definition: To address, speak to, or converse with someone directly.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive speech verb; the Quranic occurrences involve direct address to a person or group.

senses.definition: The matter, affair, or undertaking at issue.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the matter about which an explanation is sought or which occupies the speaker; Quranic contexts use it in questions about a person's or group's affair.

senses.definition: Speech, discourse, or an address directed to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Denotes verbal address or discourse; the Quran uses it both for speech itself and for addressing someone.

senses.definition: Decisive discourse or judgment that settles a case and distinguishes truth from falsehood.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested interpretation of the fixed expression فَصْلُ الْخِطَابِ; the expression is explained as deciding a case, discerning truth from falsehood, or delivering a conclusive formula such as أَمَّا بَعْدُ.

senses.definition: The act of asking a woman in marriage; a marriage proposal.
senses.usage_conditions: Denotes seeking marriage or the proposal associated with that act; it is the noun used in the Quranic expression خِطْبَةِ النِّسَاءِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sermon, exhortation, public speech, or self-contained discourse or oration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially a discourse recited publicly by a خَطِيب, including a pulpit sermon; it may also denote a complete short treatise or discourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or desire to do a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended usage in which the desired action or undertaking is expressed as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A public speaker, orator, preacher, or reciter of a sermon; a speaker for a people or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related verb may describe becoming such a speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant a man's request for a woman in marriage or give a woman in marriage to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II marriage-related causative or transitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particle of allocution or grammatical address.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical-terminological use, as in the addressing elements of pronouns and demonstratives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To consult or confer with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extension of the Form III speech relation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invite or induce someone for the purpose of marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a Form IV usage by one authority, though the lexical entry questions whether this meaning properly belongs to Form IV rather than Form VIII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become within one's power, reach, or proximity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of game, an object of pursuit, or an affair that has come within someone's reach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To converse, speak, or hold a dialogue with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI use; it also underlies the expression for the conventional language of conversation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To invite a man to marry a woman of one's family, or to invite him to seek her in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII marriage-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great or grievous affair, a calamity or affliction, the cause or occasion of an event, or a state or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical extensions of the affair noun beyond the Quranic matter-at-issue use; the word may also denote a sought or desired undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who asks or demands a woman in marriage; a marriage suitor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine and related forms may designate the person sought in marriage; intensified forms are also used for a frequent suitor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who is asked or demanded in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine participant meaning distinct from the male suitor sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turbid, dusky, or variegated coloration combining tones such as yellowish red, green, black, or ash.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to animals, plants, dyed body parts, hair, lips, and other things; خُطْبَانِيٌّ intensifies the dusky coloration. The related verb may mean to become striped or colored.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression أَنْتَ الْبَيِّنُ الْخُطْبَةِ, bearing clear signs of asinineness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed idiomatic interpretation, not the ordinary meaning of sermon or discourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular very bitter herb resembling asparagus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name; it is also used in a comparison for extreme bitterness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or function of a mosque preacher.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized institutional noun derived from the preaching and sermon branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man practiced in or accustomed to asking women in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive or habitual designation related to the marriage-suitor branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird called the أخطب, identified in different reports with a roller or a shrike.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is associated with the mixture of black and white in the bird's coloring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hawk or falcon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate animal-name use of the adjective or noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A green, six-legged creeping creature longer than a locust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological name recorded for a particular small creature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular bird, named for the green coloration in its wings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper bird name derived from the color branch.

cautions: The root contains a separate Classical color branch alongside the speech, marriage, and affair branches; the color meanings are not Quranic form senses in this packet.
The Form IV marriage-invitation meaning is retained as a qualified Classical report because the same Lane entry questions whether it belongs to Form IV rather than Form VIII.
The bird identification for أَخْطَبُ varies between roller and shrike in the supplied evidence.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The attribution of the marriage-invitation meaning to Form IV أَخْطَبَ is uncertain in the supplied Lane passage; it is represented with that qualification rather than silently omitted.
